source.generator: Byte-identical frozen F124-Q public constructor with bound-only new seed cohorts, new per-seed SHA salt remains injective; no new graph generator and no Q FIT/DEV replay.

Wingless.hypothesis: Uniform-anchored four-channel residual produces transferable key compression using only fresh FIT gradient and frozen pretrained F124-O head
Wingless.forward: Exact F124-Q anchored residual model, public graph only
Wingless.resource_budget: Original 3 per-node state limit, maximum 192 active states

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: F124-Q discrete top-seven/nine retention blocks SPSA; a continuous role-consistent public-key path-mass surrogate can train the same two lookahead coefficients without changing 7+9 hard inference
Yggdrasil.forward: Exact F124-Q public next-key lookahead 7+9 cell forward at inference; no source labels or oracle inside predictor
Yggdrasil.fit_signal: Differentiable logsumexp mass fraction of target-terminal public routes over all terminal public routes; path energy includes preexisting learned raw-key compatibility plus 2 bounded lookahead coefficients; labels only in FIT loss, never inferencer
Yggdrasil.resource_budget: 7 active plus 9 retained, no extra inferential cells; surrogate TRAIN cost recorded separately

training.SPSA: deterministic two-sided with frozen F124-Q RNG salting, Wingless original paired BCE, Yggdrasil novel soft path mass paired BCE + 0.15 contrastive

evaluation.cost_matching: No matched-compute superiority assertion unless resource-equivalent verified on same public graphs and predeclared accounting; record unequal operation units separately.
evaluation.candidate_verdict: FIT-only learned delta may win or lose; retain all negative results; no science acceptance.
